We need DBE for C8H10BrN. DBE formula: DBE = C - H/2 + N/2 +1 (halogens count as H). So treat Br as H. So effective H = 10 + 1 =11? Actually halogen counts as hydrogen, so H_equiv = H + X = 10 +1 =11. Then DBE = C - (H_eq)/2 + N/2 +1 = 8 - 11/2 + 1/2 +1 = 8 -5.5 +0.5 +1 = 4. So DBE = 4. Provide integer 4.

We could retrieve formula via tool but we know. Could call retrieve_dbe_formula just to be safe.
